items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So I went with the band, and they added Ben Webster... He had no parts; he made his own... Well, he did the same thing with John Kirby's band

ctx.x: Well, no, the office building -- it's now the City Squire, which is turned into the Sheraton Hotel now, where that same place was. It's now the Sheraton there, Roseland and the Roosevelt was upstairs, and ...

During this period of time, Charlie Shavers who apparently -- we had just worked together for the first time, and Ben and I got along so well, Charlie said John Kirby is going to reorganize. Would you like another gig? Now we were off the air at five o'clock -- we rehearsed from like twelve o'clock noon and we were off the air at five, and he said -- and remember, this was the thick of the warfare around the world -- World War II.
And there was a place called The Aquarium.
